#set par(justify: true, leading: 0.53em)
#set list(indent: 8pt, body-indent: 5pt)

#grid(
  columns: (colw, colw, colw),
  column-gutter: gutter,
  align: top,

  [
    #sec[Background]
    #para[
      Quantifying ecosystem characteristics is the cornerstone of data-driven conservation and restoration policy, and multiple data streams are employed for this purpose. Biological sampling information, collected for example with trawl nets [1], has been used in concert with acoustic data, but there is recent interest in non-lethal eDNA sampling as a tool to complement acoustic surveying. For instance, shifts in eDNA profiles accompanying organism movement as measured by acoustic sensors have been assessed [2], and paired hydroacoustic and eDNA surveys have been evaluated by replicating samples along the depth gradient of a pelagic lake habitat [3]. The current study investigates complementarity between eDNA, purse seine, and acoustic data gathered at three sites in July 2025 for quantification of ecosystem characteristics.
    ]


    #sec[Methods]
    #sub[Data collection]
    #para[
      #list(
        [Three sites (Oak Bay, Willow Island (San Juan Islands), and Squamish Harbor) were selected to capture a broad spatial extent around the Salish Sea.],
        [At each site, purse seine captures were conducted by Long Live the Kings using a herring net. Seining began at a depth of between 33.1 meters and 44.3 meters.],
        [Acoustic transects were performed using a BioSonics DTX to capture an area approximately representative of the purse seine catch at each site.],
        [Concurrent eDNA samples were collected using a Niskin Rosette at six depths at a central point at each site.])
      ]
    #sub[Data analysis]
    #para[
    #list(
        [Acoustic survey data from a BioSonics DTX were processed in EchoView, and Sv integration results by 10-meter-squared cell were exported.],
        [Reads resulting from MiFish primer amplification were assigned using the Tronko algorithm [4], and taxonomic assignments with at most 10% divergence were retained.],
        [A combined data set was constructed with purse seine data indexed by site and with acoustic data and eDNA data indexed by site and 10-meter depth layer.]
    )
    ]
    #v(0.08in)
    #align(center)[#text(size: 20pt, weight: 700)[Map of the study area]]
